answer: The base protein level of ENO1 in normal samples is 7.29e7 (72,900,000), rounded to 3 significant figures. This value is the Normal-group raw MS intensity of alpha-enolase (protein P06733, gene ENO1) taken directly from the "Normal" column of the "Tumor vs Normal" worksheet in "Proteomic_data .xlsx"; no back-transformation or aggregation was applied, and MeRIP_RNA_result.xlsx was disregarded as irrelevant (RNA/m6A-level data, no protein abundance).
